component: Folder comparator callers and insertion order

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: FolderUtils.compareFolders reads sortOrder and localizedName from folder objects. In the checked historical landing, offline and virtual-folder children are FolderRow wrappers with the folder stored in _folder, yet the comparator receives each wrapper directly. The fixed dialogs use FolderSelectionDataAdapter, which sorts raw subFolders before constructing rows. The same historical landing also changed an insertion loop from descending to ascending order despite stopping at the insertion point; fixed source uses reverse(). Preserve both the compared value and the loop direction when replacing a comparator. These are scoped historical/current source differences, not a current defect or a runtime reproduction. The fixed shared collator uses numeric:true; the older sensitivity:base setting is historical.
title: Folder sorting must preserve the receiver and traversal contracts
